extDescription.message: Convert images, documents, PDFs and data files right in your browser, with offline text recognition. Nothing is uploaded.

menuOpenDashboard.message: 🚀 Open the full File Converter Dashboard

dropHint.message: Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, DOCX, PDF, JSON, CSV, MD...

autoConvertToggle.message: Also save a PNG or JPG copy when you download a .webp/.jfif image

autoConvertNote.message: This needs access to all sites, to read the images you download. Switch it on again and choose "Allow" when the browser asks.

failureAccess.message: Couldn't read the image from $SITE$: the extension isn't allowed to access that site. Choose "Allow" when the browser asks, or allow all sites.

failureFailed.message: Couldn't convert the image from $SITE$. It may have been removed, or it isn't an image format that can be read.

needTwoPdfs.message: At least 2 PDF files are needed

converterIntro.message: Drag and drop files or whole folders to convert them in bulk, 100% client-side

dashDropTitle.message: Drag & drop files or folders here

dashDropHint.message: Or click to choose from your computer

formatPdfMerge.message: Merge the PDF files into one (.pdf)

formatOcrPdf.message: Searchable PDF with OCR, from scans or images (.pdf)

ocrPdfNeedsScan.message: Searchable PDF needs a scanned PDF or an image

splitRangesLabel.message: Pages to take out (empty = one file per page):

pageOrderLabel.message: New page order (pages left out follow in their old order):

queueEmpty.message: No files in the queue yet.

aiStudioTitle.message: 🔎 OCR & Background Removal (100% on your device)

aiStudioIntro.message: Extract text from images (OCR) and remove image backgrounds, completely offline in the browser

ocrCardTitle.message: 📄 AI OCR - Extract text from images / scans

ocrCardHint.message: Choose a photo of text, or a scanned document (image or PDF), to extract Vietnamese / English text

ocrResultPlaceholder.message: The recognised text will appear here...

ocrPickFile.message: Please choose a photo or a scan to read with OCR!

ocrNoText.message: No text was found in the image.

ocrBundleMissing.message: The offline Tesseract package was not found in the extension. Run "npm run build" to package it again.

bgCardTitle.message: ✂️ Plain-background removal - to a transparent PNG

bgCardHint.message: Reads the background colour from the image's edges, spreads over the area of that colour and smooths the outline. Works best for product photos / cards on a single-colour background; a complex background will not come out clean.

bgZoomHint.message: 🔍 Click the image to zoom in on the details

bgPlaceholder.message: The transparent PNG will be previewed here

bgPickFile.message: Please choose an image to remove its background!

bgAnalysing.message: Reading the background colour and tracing the outline...

bgLowResult.message: ⚠️ Only $PERCENT$% of the image was cleared — the background may not be one colour. Raise the sensitivity and try again.

bgResult.message: ✅ Cleared $PERCENT$% as background (background colour found: $COLOR$). Click the image to zoom in

lightboxPreviewTitle.message: Preview of the image without its background

devtoolsIntro.message: Generate TypeScript, Go structs, Base64 & Data URIs from your data

jsonInputTitle.message: Paste JSON or load a data file

securityIntro.message: Stamp a copyright text on the images you convert. Location data (Exif GPS) never survives a conversion.

watermarkEnable.message: Stamp this text on the images converted in the Batch File Converter

exifNote.message: Exif metadata (GPS location, camera details) is always removed from converted images.

settingsIntro.message: The automatic conversions and the interface

autoConvertSettingTitle.message: Also save a PNG or JPG copy on download (Chrome Downloads)

autoConvertSettingDesc.message: When you download a .webp or .jfif image on the web, the extension saves a copy in the format chosen below, beside the original. This needs access to all sites, to read the image; the browser asks when you switch it on.

autoFormatSettingDesc.message: PNG keeps transparency; JPG gives a smaller file.

autoConvertSettingNote.message: Not switched on: choose "Allow" when the browser asks for access to all sites.

languageSettingDesc.message: The language of the extension's windows and of its right-click menu.

pdfPasswordLabel.message: PDF password (only for a PDF locked with one):

pdfPasswordNeeded.message: $NAME$ is locked with a password: enter it in the PDF password field and convert again.

pdfPasswordNeededPopup.message: $NAME$ is locked with a password: open it in the Dashboard and enter the password there.

formatPdfNumber.message: Add page numbers to a PDF (.pdf)

numberStartLabel.message: Number of the first page (0 leaves a cover unnumbered):

cropIntro.message: Keep part of a picture and mirror it, on your device. PNG, JPG, WebP and BMP keep their format; other pictures come out as PNG.

cropPlaceholder.message: Choose a picture, then drag over it to mark the part to keep

cropEmpty.message: The part to keep is empty: give it a width and a height of 1 or more

formatPdfStamp.message: Stamp a PDF with a text or a picture (.pdf)

pagesToStampLabel.message: Pages to stamp (empty or all = every page; first, last, or pages such as 1-3, 5):

stampDateLabel.message: Add today's date under the text

stampImageLabel.message: Picture, such as a signature or a logo (PNG or JPG, optional):

stampXLabel.message: Centre of the stamp, % from the left:

stampYLabel.message: Centre of the stamp, % from the top:

stampSizeLabel.message: Width, as a share of the page width:

stampTextUnsupported.message: The stamp text has characters the font built into every PDF cannot draw: $CHARS$. Write it without them, or stamp it as a picture.
